newsitem.title: USA: NIH launches free medical information web site.
newsitem.headline: NIH launches free medical information web site.

text.p: WASHINGTON, June 26, Reuter - A new service providing all Americans free access to cutting-edge medical research on the World Wide Web was launched Wednesday by Vice President Al Gore.

The service, supplied by the National Library of Medicine, which is part of the National Institutes of Health,is available through MEDLINE -- the world's most extensive collection of published medical information.
Previously users have had to register and pay a fee to search MEDLINE and other NLM databases.
